{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -c "
from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache

# Test R01: basic put/get with tags
c = TaggedCache(2)
c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
assert c.get('a') == 1, 'basic get failed'

# Test R01: deep copy
c.put('b', {'nested': [1,2]}, ['y'])
val = c.get('b')
val['nested'].append(3)
assert c.get('b') == {'nested': [1,2]}, 'deep copy failed'

# Test R01: string rejected as tags
try:
    c.put('k', 'v', 'tag')
    assert False, 'should have raised'
except ValueError:
    pass

# Test R01: non-string tag rejected
try:
    c.put('k', 'v', [1])
    assert False, 'should have raised'
except ValueError:
    pass

# Test R02: invalidate
c2 = TaggedCache(3)
c2.put('a', 1, ['x'])
c2.put('b', 2, ['x','y'])
c2.put('c', 3, ['y'])
assert c2.invalidate('x') == 2, f'expected 2, got {c2.invalidate("x")}'
assert len(c2) == 1

# Test R02: replacement removes old tags
c3 = TaggedCache(2)
c3.put('a', 1, ['old'])
c3.put('a', 2, ['new'])
assert c3.invalidate('old') == 0
assert c3.get('a') == 2

# Test R03: maxsize validation
try:
    TaggedCache(True)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
try:
    TaggedCache(0)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
try:
    TaggedCache(-1)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass

# Test R04: invalidate_many
cc = TaggedCache(5)
cc.put('a', 1, ['x'])
cc.put('b', 2, ['x','y'])
cc.put('c', 3, ['y','z'])
assert cc.invalidate_many(['x','z']) == 3
assert len(cc) == 0

# mode='all'
cc2 = TaggedCache(5)
cc2.put('a', 1, ['x','y'])
cc2.put('b', 2, ['x'])
cc2.put('c', 3, ['y'])
assert cc2.invalidate_many(['x','y'], mode='all') == 1
assert len(cc2) == 2

# Test R05: resize
cc3 = TaggedCache(3)
cc3.put('a', 1, ['x'])
cc3.put('b', 2, ['x'])
cc3.put('c', 3, ['x'])
cc3.resize(2)
assert len(cc3) == 2
assert 'a' not in cc3  # LRU evicted
assert cc3.maxsize == 2

# Test R06: generator tags
cc4 = TaggedCache(2)
cc4.put('k', 'v', (t for t in ['a','b']))
assert cc4.get('k') == 'v'
assert cc4.invalidate('a') == 1

# Test R07: TTL
clock = [0]
c4 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: clock[0])
c4.put('a', 1, ttl=2)
assert c4.get('a') == 1
clock[0] = 2  # exactly at boundary
assert c4.get('a') == 1  # not yet expired (now == expiry)
clock[0] = 3  # past boundary
try:
    c4.get('a')
    assert False
except KeyError:
    pass

# TTL zero immediately expired
c5 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: clock[0])
c5.put('a', 1, ttl=0)
try:
    c5.get('a')
    assert False
except KeyError:
    pass

# Invalid TTL
try:
    c5.put('b', 1, ttl=-1)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
try:
    c5.put('b', 1, ttl=float('inf'))
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
try:
    c5.put('b', 1, ttl=True)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass

# Invalid mode
try:
    c5.invalidate_many(['x'], mode='invalid')
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass

# Invalid maxsize on resize
try:
    c5.resize(False)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass

# Empty tags removes nothing
assert c5.invalidate_many([]) == 0
assert c5.invalidate_many([], mode='all') == 0

print('All manual tests passed!')
"
"}
